Content.SourceString: 你也收到「袋先生Tips」的信息了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Did you get "Mr. Bag's Tips" info too?

Content.SourceString: 收到了，不过……「苦蛋糕」是什么？这次爆发不会对店里有影响吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Got it, but… what is Bittercake? Will this affect the store?

Content.SourceString: 顾名思义嘛，「苦蛋糕」就是会让蛋糕变苦的异象。「苦蛋糕」爆发后桥间地范围内所有的蛋糕都可能变得苦苦的……怎么想这种蛋糕都不会有人喜欢吃才对吧！
Content.LocalizedString: As the name suggests, Bittercake is an Anomaly that makes cakes bitter. After the Bittercake incident, all cakes in Bridge Crossings might become bitter… Who would like that, right?

Content.SourceString: 一般来说蛋糕还是甜的才正常吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Normally, cakes are supposed to be sweet, right?!

Content.SourceString: 虽然听起来就很像黑暗料理……或许真的会有喜欢这种奇怪蛋糕的人呢？
Content.LocalizedString: It sounds like dark cuisine, but maybe strange cakes like that have their own fan base?

Content.SourceString: 不过，无论如何这段时间来店里的顾客都会变少吧？
Content.LocalizedString: But I guess there'll be fewer customers coming to the shop during this time anyway?

Content.SourceString: 啊哈哈……
Content.LocalizedString: Ahaha…

Content.SourceString: 该怎么说呢……具体怎么样可能来店里看一下比较好……
Content.LocalizedString: How should I put this… It might be better if you came to the shop and saw for yourself…

Content.SourceString: 上次的蛋糕怎么样，好吃吗？
Content.LocalizedString: How were those cakes from last time? Did you enjoy them?

Content.SourceString: 蛋糕的味道很不错，很喜欢。
Content.LocalizedString: The cakes were delicious. I really enjoyed them.

Content.SourceString: 我把蛋糕带回去分给朋友了，那可是好评如潮啊！
Content.LocalizedString: I shared the cakes with my friends, and they really liked it!

Content.SourceString: 太好了！我之前还担心会不合你们口味呢。
Content.LocalizedString: That's wonderful! I was worried they might not suit your tastes.

Content.SourceString: 今天打算做一些不同口味的蛋糕让大家试吃，感兴趣的话要来店里试试哦！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm planning to make some cakes with different flavors for everyone to try today. If you're interested, do come by the shop!

Content.SourceString: 我会多准备一些的，这样你还能带一些再分给朋友们！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll make sure to prepare extra so you can take some to share with your friends again!

OptionText.LocalizedString: I'm really looking forward to it!

Content.SourceString: 真是让人期待啊，不过记得这次可不要少了菈比那份。
Content.LocalizedString: I can't wait! But let's remember to leave some for Rabi.

Content.SourceString: 虽然菈比气鼓鼓的样子也很可爱就是了。
Content.LocalizedString: Though, Rabi does look pretty cute when she's all pouty…

Content.SourceString: www不用担心，这次我会提前给菈比做好她的那份的！
Content.LocalizedString: Hehe, don't worry! I'll make something just for Rabi!

Content.SourceString: 不过，记得不要随便摸菈比的耳朵哦。未经允许随便摸她的耳朵，她可是真的会生气的！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh! One thing! Seriously, do not touch Rabi's ears. Rabi gets really upset when people touch them without permission!

Content.SourceString: 这样啊，真可惜。
Content.LocalizedString: Aw, that's a pity.

Content.SourceString: 想摸的话就需要再努力一下咯。
Content.LocalizedString: If you want to pet her, you'll just have to work harder for it.

Content.SourceString: 能看到吗能看到吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Can you see it? Can you see it?

Content.SourceString: 收到了，今天怎么感觉怪怪的？
Content.LocalizedString: Ermm… is something off today?

Content.SourceString: 因为不是爱丽丝，是菈比啦！
Content.LocalizedString: Because it's not Alice, it's Rabi!

Content.SourceString: 菈比的手机坏掉送修了，只能先借用一下爱丽丝的手机了。
Content.LocalizedString: My phone's being repaired, so I'm borrowing Alice's for now.

Content.SourceString: 对了，今天来店里尝尝爱丽丝新做的蛋糕吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh right! Come to the bakery today and try Alice's freshly baked cakes!

Content.SourceString: 邀请我去的话，没准会把菈比的那份吃掉的。
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks for the invite! Might just eat everything and leave nothing for you!

Content.SourceString: 既然菈比都这样邀请我了，那就去吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Sure, I'll come.

Content.SourceString: 开个玩笑
Content.LocalizedString: Just kidding

Content.SourceString: 菈比记住了呐，爱丽丝今天可是准备了新口味的蛋糕，一定要来哦！
Content.LocalizedString: Rabi remembers! Alice is preparing a cake with a new flavor today. Make sure to come try it!

Content.SourceString: 要是不来的话，哼哼……
Content.LocalizedString: If you don't… hmmpf…

Content.SourceString: 菈比最近很不开心！
Content.LocalizedString: Rabi's been feeling down lately!

Content.SourceString: 是因为最近爆发的异象「苦蛋糕」吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is it because of the recent Bittercake anomaly?

Content.SourceString: 嗯嗯！一提到这个可恶的异象菈比就来气！
Content.LocalizedString: Yes! Just mentioning this awful anomaly makes Rabi angry!

Content.SourceString: 有空的话来店里见面说吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Come by the shop when you're free and we can talk!

Content.SourceString: 对于大家想要用「苦蛋糕」来解决压力这种做法，{0}到底有什么看法呢？
Content.LocalizedString: {0}, what do you think about everyone trying to deal with their stress through Bittercake?

Content.SourceString: 的确是一种很便利的方式。
Content.LocalizedString: It is indeed a very convenient way.

Content.SourceString: 我不太喜欢这种解决压力的方法。
Content.LocalizedString: I don't really approve of this way of dealing with stress.

Content.SourceString: 这样吗？不过……果然我还是不喜欢「苦蛋糕」
Content.LocalizedString: Is that so? Still… I really don't like Bittercake

Content.SourceString: 原来你也是这样想的吗，太好了！
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, you think so too? That's wonderful!

Content.SourceString: 爱丽丝为什么会讨厌「苦蛋糕」呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Why does Alice hate Bittercake?

Content.SourceString: 菈比说你最近有些不开心，也是因为「苦蛋糕」吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Rabi says you've been feeling down lately. Is it also because of Bittercake?

Content.SourceString: 让你们担心了真是不好意思……
Content.LocalizedString: I'm sorry for making you worry…

Content.SourceString: 为什么会讨厌「苦蛋糕」……可能是因为，蛋糕对我来说是一种美好的象征吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Why do I hate Bittercake… I suppose it's because cake has always been a symbol of something wonderful to me.

Content.SourceString: 而且，一般会用到蛋糕的场合也是那种欢乐或者轻松的环境，对吧？
Content.LocalizedString: And normally, cake is something you'd have in happy or relaxing settings, right?

Content.SourceString: 的确如此
Content.LocalizedString: Indeed.

Content.SourceString: 所以，我想如果蛋糕可以让有烦恼的大家开心起来的话，那也是通过它甜甜的味道，又或者是蛋糕所代表着的生日呀，纪念日呀，节日这样的特殊意义。
Content.LocalizedString: So I believe if cake is going to make people feel better when they're troubled, it should be through its sweet taste, or through the special meanings it represents… like birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays.

Content.SourceString: 但是啊，如果人们通过暂时忍受味觉上的痛苦来消除压力的话……这不是跟蛋糕的本意，跟蛋糕制作者的本心完全背道而驰了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: But if people are trying to relieve stress by temporarily enduring taste-related suffering… isn't that completely against what cake is meant to be, against what cake makers intended from their hearts?

Content.SourceString: 正是如此，蛋糕本身就应该是让人享受、让人开心的东西。
Content.LocalizedString: Cakes should be something people enjoy and feel happy about.

Content.SourceString: 因为想要「苦蛋糕」的人从一开始想要的就不是「蛋糕」吧，倒不如说想要的是一种药更合适。
Content.LocalizedString: Those who want Bittercake weren't looking for a cake in the first place. They're more like looking for medicine, if anything.

Content.SourceString: 而且袋先生不也说了吗？「苦蛋糕」会造成其他异象的出现，还会让人们重新感受到压力。
Content.LocalizedString: Besides, didn't Mr. Bag say so himself? Bittercake causes other anomalies to appear and will make people stressed again.

Content.SourceString: 对啊，这样的话，「苦蛋糕」实际上也只不过是将人的坏心情藏起来而已，这样的方式简直就是犯规！
Content.LocalizedString: Exactly! Bittercake is just suppressing people's negative emotions. That's completely missing the point!

Content.SourceString: 所以菈比说你最近一直很不开心，原来是因为一直在跟「苦蛋糕」较劲吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So that's why you've been feeling down lately. You've been struggling with the Bittercake situation?

Content.SourceString: 就算「苦蛋糕」再神奇，也有像菈比和伊莱顿先生这样只会因为你的蛋糕而开心的人在的。
Content.LocalizedString: No matter how amazing Bittercake might be, there are still people like Rabi and Mr. Eliton who can only find happiness in your cakes.

Content.SourceString: 啊……果然还是瞒不过菈比啊……让你们担心了真的很抱歉，下次我会做特制的蛋糕给你们吃的！
Content.LocalizedString: Ah… I really can't hide anything from Rabi, can I? I'm so sorry for making you all worry. I'll make you a special cake next time to make up for it!

Content.SourceString: 多亏了你呐，爱丽丝终于不会一天天的无精打采的了，之前从来没有在「苦蛋糕」出现的时候见到爱丽丝这么有精神过呐！
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks to you, Alice has finally stopped being so listless. I've never seen her this energetic during any of the previous Bittercake incidents!

Content.SourceString: 连带着菈比的心情都好起来了！
Content.LocalizedString: Rabi is feeling happy about it!

Content.SourceString: 能帮到爱丽丝就好。
Content.LocalizedString: Glad I could help Alice.

Content.SourceString: 对了，有空的话来一趟蛋糕店吧，爱丽丝打算做她最拿手的蛋糕来谢谢你呢。
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, come by the cake shop sometime. Alice wants to bake her best cake to thank you.

Content.SourceString: 这蛋糕之前可是只有菈比才能尝到的！不过看在你帮了爱丽丝的份上，就特别允许你跟菈比分享吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Rabi used to be the only one who could eat this cake! But since you helped Alice, Rabi will allow you to give it a try!

Content.SourceString: 最近「苦蛋糕」越来越多了啊，让客人试吃到「苦蛋糕」的次数也变多了呢……
Content.LocalizedString: There's been more and more Bittercake lately… and more customers tasted it too…

Content.SourceString: 就算有专门检查蛋糕也还是没办法避免，啊啊啊啊啊啊这个异象真的是！
Content.LocalizedString: Even if we check the cakes, we still can't prevent it… Aaaaahhh, this anomaly is just…!

Content.SourceString: 爱丽丝已经尽力避免了吧，这也不是爱丽丝的错。
Content.LocalizedString: You have done your best to prevent this. It's not your fault.

Content.SourceString: 虽然话是这么说的，但果然还是会很不爽。
Content.LocalizedString: Even if that's true, it still really bothers me.

Content.SourceString: 不过，菈比最近开始试着自己做蛋糕了哦。
Content.LocalizedString: But hey, did you know? Rabi has started trying to make cakes on her own lately.

OptionText.LocalizedString: I have a bad feeling about this.

Content.SourceString: 菈比自己做蛋糕……总感觉想象不出那副画面。
Content.LocalizedString: Rabi making cakes… I just can't picture that.

Content.SourceString: 总感觉菈比毛毛糙糙的，她来做蛋糕……真的不会把厨房炸飞吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Rabi seems pretty clumsy… Won't she end up setting the kitchen on fire?

Content.SourceString: 是啊，我一开始也想不到。
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah, I couldn't picture it at first either.

Content.SourceString: 虽然是变得一片狼藉的……但怎么说也不至于到被炸飞的状态吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Well, sure, it gets pretty messy… but it's not like the kitchen actually burned or anything!

Content.SourceString: 而且，真的有一位顾客说吃了我的蛋糕后心情都好起来了！不是因为「苦蛋糕」哦！
Content.LocalizedString: And there was even a customer who said my cake made them feel better! And not because of the Bittercake!

Content.SourceString: 就像我之前说的，总会有人因为你的蛋糕开心的。
Content.LocalizedString: That's what I told you! Your cakes will always make someone happy.

Content.SourceString: 嗯！我会继续努力，做出更美味的蛋糕的！
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah! I'll keep working hard to make even more delicious cakes!

Content.SourceString: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊那家伙！
Content.LocalizedString: Ahhhhhhh, that guy!

Content.SourceString: 幽灵又出现在你尾巴上了？
Content.LocalizedString: Is the ghost on your tail again?

Content.SourceString: 手机修好了？
Content.LocalizedString: Is your phone fixed now?

Content.SourceString: 那种事情不重要啦！
Content.LocalizedString: That's not important right now!

Content.SourceString: 那家伙不是说留了个礼物吗，你看看它留下的是什么啊！
Content.LocalizedString: Didn't the ghost say they left a gift? Look what they actually left behind!

Content.SourceString: 那家伙不是说留了个礼物吗，你看看它留下的是什么啊！
Content.LocalizedString: Didn't the ghost say they left a gift? Look what they actually left behind!

OptionText.LocalizedString: Is it a new item for the store?

Content.SourceString: 这不是挺可爱的吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Isn't that cute?

Content.SourceString: 伊莱顿先生研制的新品吗，感觉能大卖！
Content.LocalizedString: Is this one of Mr. Eliton's new creations? It looks like it'll be a hit!

Content.SourceString: 是那个家伙留下来的，菈比才不要啊！伊莱顿先生还要把这个蛋糕摆在橱窗里！
Content.LocalizedString: That thing left it here! No way I want it! But Mr. Eliton is even displaying this cake in the window!

Content.SourceString: 这下不是大家都知道菈比之前尾巴被幽灵「吃掉」了吗！
Content.LocalizedString: Now everyone's going to know my tail had been eaten by a ghost before!

Content.SourceString: 不是谁都能有这种经历的啦，留作纪念不是挺好的吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Not everyone gets to experience something like this, wouldn't it be nice to keep it as a memento?

Content.SourceString: 才不好啦！
Content.LocalizedString: No way!

Content.SourceString: 要是不来的话，哼哼……
Content.LocalizedString: If you don't… hmmpf…

Content.SourceString: 有空的话来店里见面说吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Come by the shop when you're free and we can talk!

Content.SourceString: 这蛋糕之前可是只有菈比才能尝到的！不过看在你帮了爱丽丝的份上，就特别允许你跟菈比分享吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Rabi used to be the only one who could eat this cake! But since you helped Alice, Rabi will allow you to give it a try!
